gloss: to inherit; to succeed to; to carry on

definitions.gloss: to inherit; to succeed to; to carry on
definitions.explanation: To receive and continue something from a predecessor — traditions, techniques, positions, or property. Emphasizes the continuation of what was passed down.

examples.japanese: {伝統|でんとう}を{継承|けいしょう}する。
{父|ちち}の{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{継承|けいしょう}した。
{地域|ちいき}の{文化|ぶんか}を{次|つぎ}の{世代|せだい}に{継承|けいしょう}していくことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to pass on the local culture to the next generation.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used for traditions, cultural practices, techniques, titles, and positions being passed from one generation or person to the next. Common in discussions of cultural preservation and succession.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝統|でんとう}を{継承|けいしょう}する (to carry on a tradition)
- {文化|ぶんか}を{継承|けいしょう}する (to inherit a culture)
- {技|わざ}を{継承|けいしょう}する (to carry on a craft/technique)
- {王位|おうい}を{継承|けいしょう}する (to succeed to the throne)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受|う}け{継|つ}ぐ: to inherit, to take over — native Japanese verb, slightly less formal
- {相続|そうぞく}する: to inherit — specifically for legal inheritance of property and assets
